instruction: Create a new georeferenced one-storey office layout in Bonsai, save the IFC model as result.ifc, and export a space area schedule as result.csv using a Bonsai or IfcCSV-style IFC data export. Start from a blank project; no local reference images are provided. The IFC4 model should have one project, one building storey named Level 00, and no building element proxies. Include exactly three spaces named Office, Meeting, and WC. Their Qto_SpaceBaseQuantities NetFloorArea values should be 28.00 m2, 8.58 m2, and 3.90 m2 respectively, within 0.05 m2. Include exactly six walls named South Wall, East Wall, North Wall, West Wall, Meeting Partition, and WC Partition, plus one slab named Office Slab. The combined geometric bounding box of those walls and the slab should span 9.00 m in X, 6.00 m in Y, and 3.00 m in Z, each within 0.05 m. Add one IfcProjectedCRS with Name EPSG:3857, MapProjection Pseudo-Mercator, and MapZone Zone-Local. Add one IfcMapConversion with Eastings 498765.00, Northings 6812345.00, OrthogonalHeight 35.00, XAxisAbscissa 1.00, XAxisOrdinate 0.00, and Scale 1.00, each within 0.01. The CSV must use the exact header order SpaceName, Level, NetFloorArea and contain one row each for Office, Meeting, and WC. Every row should list Level as Level 00, and each NetFloorArea value should match the corresponding IFC quantity within 0.05 m2. Other details may vary.
